hook.text: Microsoft Office bundles Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook. Most people mainly use just one.

buildup.text: Selling the suite at $150 captures more revenue than selling each app for $50 individually.

discovery.text: Bundling reduces price sensitivity. Buyers compare the total package, not individual component prices.

twist.text: Adobe switched from selling Photoshop ($700 once) to a full Creative Cloud bundle at $55/month.

climax.text: Product suites increase stickiness: the more tools you use, the harder it is to switch providers.

punchline.text: Use one, pay for all. Suites lock you in by default.

quiz.question: Why do product suites increase customer retention?
options: Using multiple tools raises switching costs
